## Fixes

- A session deleted in LearnHarness no longer comes back after syncing with another computer. The plugin resolves that incoming change itself, keeps the deletion on both sides, and saves every discarded version under `.learnharness-git-backup/`.
- Sync refuses to rewrite a learning file that has uncommitted changes and names it, instead of overwriting the edit.
- A clone that cannot write every file now fails with the missing paths instead of reporting success, restores what was there, and can be retried in the same folder.
- A failed clone removes only the files it wrote itself, so a file another program created during the attempt survives.
- The change viewer only reads inside the learning data folder, including when a path tries to leave through a symlink and `..`.
- A remote URL carrying credentials is refused before any Git call, including percent-encoded forms, and GitLab `glpat-` tokens are recognised again.
- The notice after an automatic conflict resolution now states the rule that was actually applied instead of always claiming the newest version won.

Full changelog: https://github.com/heohlee/learnharness-git/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
Documentation: https://github.com/heohlee/learnharness-git#readme
